versions.changelog:
- Improved English documentation for all navigation sections, replacing mixed Chinese/English descriptions.
- Clarified reference topics, feature explanations, and example code comments for greater clarity.
- No functional or API changes—documentation only.

Initial release of the Claude Code Agent SDK documentation.

- Provides comprehensive guides for building production AI agents with Claude Code in Python or TypeScript.
- Covers quickstart, agent loops, message types, and session management.
- Includes details on tool integration, custom hooks, permissions, and sub-agent orchestration.
- Documents advanced features: streaming outputs, cost tracking, security, and hosting best practices.
- Organized API references and migration guides for both Python and TypeScript users.
